current.headline: PSG put Bradley Barcola up for sale at €150m to trigger Premier League bidding war
current.summary: Paris Saint-Germain have reportedly informed several English clubs that winger Bradley Barcola is available for transfer this summer as they seek to generate a €150m bidding war, with Arsenal, Liverpool and Manchester United interested.
